description: End-to-end lifecycle management of unified communications (UC) resources for B2B telco customers, from solution design and capacity checks through provisioning, modification, incident handling, and decommissioning.

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier for a B2B customer tenant (organization/account).

solution_id.description: Identifier for a designed UC solution blueprint for a tenant.

proposal_id.description: Identifier for a commercial/technical offer generated from a solution design.

order_id.description: Identifier for a UC provisioning order raised against an accepted proposal.

site_id.description: Identifier for a customer site or location where UC services are deployed.

resource_group_id.description: Identifier for a logical group of UC resources provisioned together (e.g., per site or per department).

user_profile_id.description: Identifier for a UC user profile template (e.g., standard, power user, contact center agent).

incident_id.description: Identifier for an incident or fault ticket associated with UC resources.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier for a rollback plan that can be executed to revert a failed change.

functions.name: design_uc_solution
functions.description: Create a high-level unified communications solution design for a tenant, including sites, capacity, and feature sets.

tenant_id.description: Tenant for which the solution is being designed.

name.description: Human-readable name of the solution design.

description.description: Detailed description of the UC solution scope.

sites.description: List of customer sites included in the solution.

site_id.description: Existing site identifier, or omitted for new site creation.

regulatory_region.description: Region code relevant for telecom regulation.

features.description: Requested UC feature sets for this site.

user_profiles.description: Definitions of user profile templates included in this solution.

user_profile_id.description: Existing user profile ID, if referencing an existing template.

code.description: Short code for the profile, e.g., STD_USER, POWER_USER.

features.description: Feature toggles for this user profile.

constraints.description: Technical or commercial constraints to apply to the design.

functions.returns: Created solution design with solution_id, normalized sites and user profile templates, plus an initial feasibility assessment.

functions.name: check_uc_capacity_and_eligibility
functions.description: Validate that the designed UC solution can be supported given network capacity, regulatory constraints, and platform limits.

solution_id.description: Identifier of the UC solution to validate.

validation_scope.description: Types of validation checks to perform.

sites_filter.description: Optional subset of site_ids to validate; if omitted, all sites are validated.

what_if_changes.description: Optional hypothetical changes to capacity/feature sets to simulate eligibility (not persisted).

functions.returns: Detailed eligibility report per site and validation_scope, including blocking issues, warnings, and suggested remediation steps.

functions.name: generate_uc_proposal
functions.description: Generate a commercial and technical proposal from a validated UC solution design.

solution_id.description: Solution to generate a proposal for.

billing_preferences.description: Billing and invoicing preferences for the proposal.

approval_workflow.description: Internal approval routing for the proposal.

functions.returns: Generated proposal with proposal_id, itemized pricing, terms, and internal approval status.

functions.name: submit_uc_order
functions.description: Create a UC provisioning order from an approved proposal, including initial deployment parameters.

tenant_id.description: Tenant placing the order (must match proposal).

purchase_order_reference.description: Customer purchase order number or reference.

site_deployment_plan.description: Deployment sequence and windows per site.

change_window.description: Preferred change window for deployment at this site.

initial_admin_contacts.description: Tenant-side UC administrators for this order.

numbering_plan_preferences.description: Preferences for DID ranges and extension patterns.

functions.returns: Created order with order_id, initial status, and derived deployment schedule.

functions.name: get_uc_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve detailed status, milestones, and current blockers for a UC order.

include.description: Optional additional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Order header, per-site status, milestones, deployment windows, and any associated incidents or blockers.

functions.name: provision_uc_resource_group
functions.description: Provision a UC resource group (e.g., per site or department) as part of an order, including trunks, SBCs, and UC tenants.

order_id.description: Order this resource group belongs to.

site_id.description: Site where this resource group is deployed.

resource_group_name.description: Human-readable name for the resource group.

topology.description: Technical topology of the UC deployment for this group.

sbc_clusters.description: Session border controller clusters for this group.

admin_settings.description: Administrative settings to apply to the resource group.

rollback_plan.description: Rollback plan details for this provisioning action.

functions.returns: Provisioned resource group with resource_group_id, allocated resources, and current provisioning status.

functions.name: assign_uc_users_to_resource_group
functions.description: Assign users and user profiles to a UC resource group, optionally provisioning numbers and devices.

resource_group_id.description: Target resource group for user assignments.

external_user_id.description: Customer-side identifier for the user (e.g., HR system ID).

extension.description: Requested extension number; may be auto-assigned if omitted.

devices.description: Devices to associate with this user.

number_assignment_mode.description: How to handle DID/extension assignments when conflicts occur.

send_welcome_emails.description: Whether to send welcome emails to newly provisioned users.

functions.returns: Assignment results with per-user provisioning status, assigned extensions/DIDs, and any conflicts or errors.

functions.name: modify_uc_resource_group
functions.description: Modify an existing UC resource group, including capacity changes, feature toggles, and configuration updates.

change_request_id.description: External change request or ticket reference.

changes.description: Set of changes to apply to the resource group.

rollback_plan.description: Rollback plan details for this change.

risk_level.description: Assessed risk level for the change.

functions.returns: Change task with status, applied deltas, and reference to rollback_plan_id if created.

functions.name: rollback_uc_change
functions.description: Execute a rollback plan to revert a provisioning or change operation on a UC resource group.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier of the rollback plan to execute.

resource_group_id.description: Resource group affected by the rollback.

mode.description: Whether the rollback should be fully automated or executed with operator confirmations.

confirmations.description: Pre-rollback confirmations required for guided mode.

functions.returns: Rollback execution result including steps performed, success/failure per step, and final resource_group state.

functions.name: open_uc_incident
functions.description: Open an incident related to UC services for a tenant, linking affected resource groups and sites.

description.description: Detailed description of the problem observed.

related_order_id.description: Order associated with the incident, if applicable.

functions.returns: Created incident with incident_id, initial status, and assigned support queue.

functions.name: get_uc_incident_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and timeline of an existing UC incident.
functions.returns: Incident details including status, impact, timeline, associated changes, and latest communication updates.

functions.name: retry_uc_provisioning_step
functions.description: Retry a failed provisioning step for a UC resource group, optionally with adjusted parameters.

resource_group_id.description: Resource group with a failed provisioning step.

failed_step_id.description: Identifier of the failed provisioning step.

parameter_overrides.description: Optional parameter overrides for the failed step when using parameter adjustment.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for this step.

functions.returns: Retry job status including attempts, outcome, and any remaining errors or required manual actions.

functions.name: decommission_uc_resource_group
functions.description: Gracefully decommission a UC resource group, including user migration or disconnection and resource release.

strategy.description: Approach for handling the resource group and its users.

user_migration_target.description: Target for user migration when using migrate_users strategy.

grace_period_days.description: Optional grace period before final disconnection.

number_retention.description: How to handle DIDs and extensions upon decommission.

functions.returns: Decommission plan and job status, including affected users, numbers, and resource release timeline.

functions.name: search_uc_resource_groups
functions.description: Faceted search across UC resource groups with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of UC resource group summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_uc_resource_groups
functions.description: Create multiple UC resource groups in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created UC resource group ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_uc_resource_groups
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many UC resource groups with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each UC resource group, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_uc_resource_groups
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many UC resource groups in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each UC resource group, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_uc_resource_groups
functions.description: Export UC resource group datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_uc_resource_groups
functions.description: Bulk-import UC resource group records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated UC resource groups.

functions.name: subscribe_to_uc_resource_group_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive UC resource group lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the UC resource group.

functions.name: get_uc_resource_group_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a UC resource group, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the UC resource group, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_uc_resource_group_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for UC resource groups using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the UC resource group action.

functions.name: simulate_uc_resource_group_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a UC resource group without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the UC resource group, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_uc_resource_group_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a UC resource group change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the UC resource group under change.

functions.name: decide_uc_resource_group_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending UC resource group approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the UC resource group.

functions.name: add_uc_resource_group_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a UC resource group for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the UC resource group.

functions.name: upload_uc_resource_group_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a UC resource group with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the UC resource group.

functions.name: create_uc_resource_group_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a UC resource group (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the UC resource group version captured.

functions.name: restore_uc_resource_group_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a UC resource group from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the UC resource group.

functions.name: get_uc_resource_group_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for UC resource groups over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the UC resource group domain context.

functions.name: get_uc_resource_group_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for UC resource groups combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the UC resource group context.

functions.name: create_uc_resource_group_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to UC resource groups with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current UC resource groups.

functions.name: evaluate_uc_resource_group_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a UC resource group in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the UC resource group.

functions.name: get_uc_resource_group_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a UC resource group including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the UC resource group, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_uc_resource_group_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a UC resource group and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the UC resource group.

functions.name: assign_uc_resource_group_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a UC resource group with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the UC resource group with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_uc_resource_groups
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more UC resource groups, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each UC resource group.

functions.name: compare_uc_resource_group_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a UC resource group with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the UC resource group, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_uc_resource_group_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to UC resource group operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of UC resource group operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_uc_resource_group_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a UC resource group and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the UC resource group, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_uc_resource_group
functions.description: Clone a UC resource group into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned UC resource group record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_uc_resource_group_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted UC resource group report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the UC resource group window covered.

functions.name: escalate_uc_resource_group
functions.description: Escalate a UC resource group to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the UC resource group.
